featured_reviews.name: Sarbjeet Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Mini Punjab, Antop Hill – A Mix of Comfort, Charm & Punjabi Flavours

Located in GTB Nagar, Sector V, Antop Hill, Mumbai, Mini Punjab stands out with its vibrant facade and warm interiors that reflect the spirit of Punjabi hospitality. The ambiance is welcoming – well-lit, clean, and cozy, with vibrant decor and neatly spaced-out seating that’s perfect for families or casual get-togethers.

Food Experience:
We ordered the Chicken Tikka, which looked tempting but sadly turned out to be a bit too dry for our liking – not as juicy or tender as expected. However, the Murgh Masallam more than made up for it. It was rich, flavorful, and paired beautifully with Jeera Rice, making it the highlight of our meal. The portion sizes are generous and filling. The mocktails and lassi menu also offer great variety – next time we’re keen to try their Dry Fruit Lassi or Guava Punch.

Service & Pricing:
Service is decent and quick enough even during rush hours. The staff is polite and attentive. As for pricing – it's affordable, especially considering the portions. Most mains range from ₹260–₹700 depending on quantity and meat choice. Breads like Laccha Paratha and Butter Cheese Garlic Naan are reasonably priced and fresh off the tandoor.

Verdict:
If you're looking for classic Punjabi dishes at pocket-friendly prices, this place is worth a visit. While not every dish hit the mark, the overall experience was satisfying. Ideal for families and groups who enjoy hearty North Indian meals in a clean, relaxed setting with the bonus of a TV screen to enhance the vibe.

Pro Tips:

Try their Murgh Masallam with Jeera rice or naan – definitely a winner.

The space is clean and Instagram-worthy, perfect for casual dining shots.

Parking may be a challenge during peak hours, plan accordingly.

featured_reviews.name: S S
featured_reviews.review_text:
Have been going to this place since childhood and had the best memories from here. Whenever I use to walk by around this place the smell of tandoori chicken, kebabs, Chinese food just used to pull me towards it.

Whenever I get chance I go with my friends just to eat tandoori items along with a chicken fried rice.

Before the hygiene never bothered me but since I have personally become a chef I can’t ignore it. But whenever I go to this place I ignore everything and just eat like a small kid.

Food is awesome taste wise and got bit expensive as compared to before but never mind. The dine in place is not suitable for families but good for group of friends.

So whenever you go must try things are white chicken, seek kebabs, tandoori chicken and fried rice. You will never go wrong with this. And if you like other parts of chicken like chicken potta (gizzard) or chicken liver then please go for it.

Thank you 🙏🏽

1. The food taste was good.
2. The decoration was nice.

Negatives:
1. The manager literally coerced me to give a 5 star review. Well! You better give me a good service for that but HELL NO! THEY DIDN'T!
2. The servers with starters just did NOT come to the row where we were seated, which was RIGHT NEXT to where they were entering from.
3. I told the manager herself, and the other boy who was sub-manager, not once or twice but multiple times, and even then they didn't give us starters even 1 damn time!
4. I agree, we were here for the function and not just for the food. But if you are behind my back for a review, might as well provide a good service.

So overall, I really would not recommend their services. I'm sorry, if you check my other reviews I am mostly very considerate.

But these guys just didn't listen to my request at all. They just kept on bringing water and juice. What do you want me to do? Overdose on liquids and keep peeing?

Also there were barely any chairs for us to have lunch. And I had to keep my plate next to the person who was collecting used plates. Nice!

So my sincere request to them is that please instruct your robotic like serving staff to apply some brains as to where to serve next instead of going to the same place like ants. While I agree that every profession should be respected but then do it properly and not for the sake of it or atleast your manager should observe it.

1 star is for their taste of food and the other is for the decoration. That's it. You asked me how were the starters without even serving me and gave me 1 paneer tikka to review and never to come back again. 😂 Hilarious!

WARNING: DO NOT HIRE  S.S GOLDEN CATERING – TOTAL FRAUD & DISASTER
Rating: 0/5 Stars(If I could give a negative rating, I would)
(AVOID AT ALL COSTS)
If you are planning a wedding or any significant family function, STAY AWAY from S.S. GOLDEN CATERING SERVICES. They are not professional caterers; they are professional scammers who specialize in ruining the most important day of your life.
The Nightmare at Sanoor Banquet (Ghatkopar West)
We booked them for a wedding on 22nd November '25 at Sanoor Banquet, and it was the BIGGEST MISTAKE OF  OUR LIVES. This team, led by owner PREMKUMAR KANOJIYA, Manager JAYESH DEVADIGA, and Assistant Manager RAVI, are running a blatant fraud.
Why They Are the Worst in the World:
Financial Fraud: They demand full payment upfront before the event. Once they have your money, their "service" turns into a nightmare.
The "Vanishing Act": After they successfully spoiled our function with their third-class service, they stopped answering all calls and messages. They have now blocked us from everywhere. They give absolute false commitments to trap customers and then disappear.
Stale & Dangerous Food: They served uncooked, stale, and cheap quality food that was unfit for human consumption. Our guests were insulted by the quality of what was on their plates.
The Plate Scam: We paid for a specific number of plates, but they provided a drastically lower quantity than what was ordered. They literally left our guests hungry while pocketing our hard-earned money.
A Warning to All Families
Premkumar Kanojiya and his team are vultures. They took our money, insulted our reputation, and destroyed the sanctity of a wedding. Be extremely careful before handing over your family functions to these people. They will promise you the world and deliver a disaster.
THEY ARE BIG FRAUDSTERS. If anyone else has been cheated by this group or comes across them, kindly inform us. Do not let them ruin another family’s special day.

Very Very Much Irritating
